_note._: This key is not a family. Keys beginning with _ are notes.
_note.one_crate_one_gui: This manifest declares only the families whose panels sit beside it, in this crate's gui/. The orchestrator merges every crate gui/manifest.json with Instruments:VISA/manifest.json into one table keyed by device type, so a family is declared exactly once, in the crate that speaks its protocol.
_note.tree_names_the_display: 'tree' names the frame tree these consoles land in. Omitting it means the Instruments tab, which is the bench; every family here names 7_Device_Consoles because a discovered device is not bench equipment.
